stem: A 2-year-old child presents with a history of recurrent ear infections and hearing loss. What is the most likely diagnosis?
explanation: Recurrent otitis media with persistent middle-ear effusion is the commonest cause of conductive hearing loss in toddlers. Cholesteatoma and mastoiditis are complications, not the usual first diagnosis.
key_note: Source had only 4 options. The cids of two recall dumps (C00196/C00481 and C00197/C00482) are attached here; their parts are written as separate items.
